headers.comment: These decks are sent to people who will open them at a laptop in an office they do not control. Nothing here should be frameable, because a deck inside somebody else's chrome is a deck whose gate can be dressed up as theirs.

The leave-behind. Long cache with a revision in the filename is the usual answer, but this file is regenerated from the page it accompanies and keeps its name, so it must not be cached past a day or a recipient re-downloads last week's argument.
